rows.title: File-first renderer V0
rows.description: Codex V0: Base-compatible loading, Graph/Kanban/Focus, fenced status writes, pyblocks example.

rows.title: Production refactor and dispatcher protocol
rows.description: Fable pass: modular backend, three fenced panel writes, area-catalog memory, init/new/status/comment CLI, /vibetracks skill for Claude and Codex, paper-minimal UI.

rows.title: Obsidian plugin wrapper
rows.description: Register vibetracks-graph/kanban/focus as custom Base views; write through processFrontMatter so live buffers are safe.

rows.title: File watching and SSE
rows.description: Replace polling (the home every 10 s, the roadmap every 30 s) with file watching and server-sent events, so a page shows an agent's write at once.

rows.title: Automatic review-packet generation
rows.description: Turn a worker run (diff, test output, screenshots) into a draft review packet without hand-authoring HTML.

rows.title: CRLF and BOM byte-fidelity for panel writes
rows.description: read_text universal newlines mean one status flip rewrites a CRLF note entirely to LF; revisions are computed over translated text. Needs raw-byte reads and newline-preserving transforms.

rows.title: Liveness the panel ages its own claims
rows.description: Cards carry their age, a quiet running claim is drawn stale, and per-track briefings feed one pinned agent per lane.

rows.title: Per-track agents and answerable review packets
rows.description: One standing prompt per track, and review packets the human answers in the page and pastes back (unmerged, never reviewed).

rows.title: Sidebar in Claude Code's visual language
rows.description: Claude Desktop's own sidebar CSS: 26 px rows, the status dots and blink, project headers, account bottom-left, phone drawer.

rows.title: Resizable sidebar and one view switcher
rows.description: Drag the sidebar edge (remembered, double-click resets); drop the left view switcher, Display and keys 1-4 stay.

rows.title: Other sessions listed open, as Claude shows them
rows.description: Sessions no track matches are listed one per row, the way Claude's sidebar shows them, not folded into one row.

rows.title: Double-click to rename in the sidebar
rows.description: Double-click a track (or session) in the sidebar to rename it in place.

rows.title: Drag a session onto a track to reassign it
rows.description: A session is not necessarily a track: drag it onto a track to pin it there.

rows.title: Sidebar five variant proposals
rows.description: Round 4: five clickable sidebar variants on real data, one merging with Claude Hub's sidebar.

rows.title: One sidebar with Claude Hub, or two
rows.description: Decide whether Vibe Tracks and Claude Hub share one sidebar component or stay two apps with one look.

rows.title: Sidebar pixel parity for the selected fill and background
rows.description: Close B2's two measured deltas against Claude's CSS: the selected fill and the background step.

rows.title: Home on derived state, the Linear initiatives table
rows.description: B1: project and track rows on one grid (target, health, progress, state, worked, last action) over GET /home.

rows.title: Display button with Rows, Table, Board and Cards
rows.description: A Linear-style Display popover with Rows / Table / Board / Cards on keys 1-4, remembered, and grouping.

rows.title: Fix the two frozen-check bugs behind the known reds
rows.description: Two one-line bugs in frozen acceptance checks and a pre-existing kinsim adapter error keep the suite at 3 reds.

rows.title: Home five variant proposals
rows.description: Round 4: five clickable home variants on real data.

rows.title: Stable and Preview chip on the home
rows.description: Show the Stable / Preview chip on the home page, which is served through the /api/ proxy.

rows.title: Sessions-only view
rows.description: A Display option that lists live sessions only, Claude Code's own view of the same data.

rows.title: The one number on top of the home
rows.description: One headline number for everything (proposed: $/t from the facility model), kept apart from attention.

rows.title: Sub-track roll-up rows
rows.description: Nested tracks: vibe-parent at any depth, a Storybook-style tree in the sidebar and Rows, parents roll up their subtree's worst state.

rows.title: Board writes for Done and Archived
rows.description: Drag a track into Done or Archived on the Board writes its status; derived columns still refuse drops.

rows.title: Review placeholder over the real needs
rows.description: B2's Review: the real /needs grouped by project, answers copied as Markdown, until a design is picked.

rows.title: Pick the review design, V1 Inbox to Zen or V3 Zen with bookends
rows.description: Choose between V1 Inbox -> Zen (93) and V3 Zen with bookends (92); default V1.

rows.title: Review mode on the real needs
rows.description: Build the picked review design over /needs: Zen, triaged order, Claude-style options, recommendation and default.

rows.title: Answers reach the loops
rows.description: An answer given in Review lands in the loop's own answer file through a fenced write.

rows.title: Media-first questions
rows.description: Loops attach images and video to their questions; Review shows them before the text.

rows.title: Age badges in Review and Zen
rows.description: Age pies on review rows and Zen steps, from a first-appeared time derived from the loops' events.

rows.title: Snooze a question
rows.description: Snooze a question, kept in a small Vibe Tracks-side store.

rows.title: Pin a comment on a spot in an image or video frame
rows.description: An answer can pin a comment on a spot in an image or a frame of a video.

rows.title: Auditor findings flow into Review
rows.description: Open findings from audit rounds show up as decisions in Review.

rows.title: Codex-model projects, a name plus one or more folders
rows.description: A project is a .vibetrack with a name and roots: [..], so one project spans several repos.

rows.title: Project page with the north star over the tracks' KPIs
rows.description: A project's page: its north star (lagging) above its tracks' KPIs (leading) on one time axis.

rows.title: New project writes its descriptor
rows.description: The New project dialog writes workspace/projects/<name>.vibetrack instead of printing it.

rows.title: Declare each project's north star
rows.description: Each project declares its north star; none is shown until one is declared.

rows.title: Project descriptors live in one of the project's roots
rows.description: Each project's descriptor moves into one of its own roots; who owns it is open.

rows.title: Project page five variant proposals
rows.description: Round 4: five clickable project-page variants on real data.

rows.title: Track page with KPIs, gates, rungs, activity, sessions and auditor
rows.description: B2's track page: soft KPIs as cards or rows, hard gates, the rung ladder, activity, sessions with Open, auditor.

rows.title: Vibe Tracks' own roadmap on its track page
rows.description: The repo's own feature notes, grouped under the five areas plus Data and Multi-machine, as the vibetracks track's roadmap.

rows.title: Track page five variant proposals and the tab set
rows.description: Round 4: five track-page variants on real data, with an inventory of tabs and a recommended tab set.

rows.title: Frontier strip on each track
rows.description: Five numbers atop each track: best KPI vs baseline, kept/discarded/errored, frontier, agents running, auditor.

rows.title: Staircase chart of every attempt
rows.description: The running best as a step line, every attempt a dot, ruler changes marked; the home sparkline is its miniature.

rows.title: Experiment tree per roadmap rung
rows.description: Each roadmap rung is a subtree of experiments, the best path highlighted.

rows.title: Experiment drawer with Summary, Diff, Cases and Logs
rows.description: Click an attempt: Summary / Diff / Cases / Logs with its change vs parent, hypothesis, model and cost.

rows.title: Track memory of dead ends
rows.description: One panel per track of dead ends, failure traces and rules every agent reads before its next try.

rows.title: The vibetracks-loop skill with a Discover phase
rows.description: A loop skill that starts a KPI-less track in Discover (propose KPIs, gates, ruler), then optimises.

rows.title: Outcomes tab
rows.description: A tab per track with KPIs start -> now, media, decisions and gates instead of code.

rows.title: Discussion on the track timeline
rows.description: People's comments, @agent requests and dated health updates on the track's timeline.

rows.title: Open in Claude Code with the right account
rows.description: Open a session in the account that owns it; new session on this track; Copy as prompt.

rows.title: Hardware track tables for deployments and models
rows.description: Deployments x KPIs with Rerun playbacks, and models x curriculum rungs, for hardware tracks.

rows.title: Derived state from Claude Code's own files
rows.description: The activity spine reads Claude Code's sessions and transcripts, no hooks; state is derived, never claimed.

rows.title: Work-track registry and KPI adapters
rows.description: One note per work track and one adapter per loop, projecting KPIs, freshness and needs.

rows.title: Needs-you documents
rows.description: Each loop's open questions as one document with recommendation, default and status, served at /needs.

rows.title: The bam-roadmap projector and live roadmap routes
rows.description: One roadmap and proof-of-done format for every loop, projected live at /roadmap/doc.

rows.title: Fenced write routes from the home
rows.description: Fenced, revision-checked write routes from the home, one per write, extending the panel's three note writes.

rows.title: Durable homes for loop data
rows.description: Move loop ledgers out of sweepable worktrees (kincal's 12 MB ledger first); re-run or archive grasping.

rows.title: Land the fivebar and kincal track adapters
rows.description: Merge the fivebar and kincal KPI adapters from their lanes, one after the other.

rows.title: Kinsim needs read from git
rows.description: Read kinsim's triage.json from git (an @git: source form), so its needs stop reading null.

rows.title: Audit sources for every track
rows.description: Declare vibe-audits globs for fivebar, kincal, scantunnel and mag; a MODEL: line in audit files.

rows.title: Experiment records with parent, session and account
rows.description: Record each attempt with its parent, KPI values, session and account, for the experiment views.

rows.title: Hooks as a second writer
rows.description: Hooks as a second writer, only after their latency across five accounts is measured.

rows.title: Retire or rewrite the vibetracks skill
rows.description: The /vibetracks skill still describes the Aug 25 Graph / Kanban / Focus dispatcher; retire or rewrite it.

rows.title: Remote prototype with hub, phone app and per-machine sync
rows.description: Per-host folders in a git share, a hub restoring file times, a phone-first app, Talk to agent.

rows.title: Remote v1 with quiet workers, Refresh and setup-machine
rows.description: Quiet workers, adaptive hub checks, Refresh, agents per machine, open-hub and setup-machine.

rows.title: The home reads other machines' sessions
rows.description: The home also reads other machines' sessions from vibetracks-share, live only as of each host's sync.

rows.title: The hub serves the new home
rows.description: The hub serves the new home instead of the old dashboard, so the phone sees the same page.

rows.title: First real install on the Windows box
rows.description: Run setup-machine for real on the Windows box (win-a); tested by dry run only so far.

rows.title: Shared hook line in the vault settings
rows.description: Add the one shared hook line to the vault's settings.json; waits on Zach's yes.

rows.title: Tailscale for the phone and instant pokes
rows.description: Tailscale ($8/mo) for the phone off the LAN and instant pokes from win-a; deferred.

rows.title: Write from the phone
rows.description: Status changes, answers and comments from the phone, through the home's fenced writes.

rows.title: Refuse a duplicate vibe-id
rows.description: A sync conflict copy with the same vibe-id loads as a named problem, not a second card.

rows.title: Swap git for Syncthing or Obsidian Headless in the share
rows.description: Swap the share's git sync for Syncthing or Obsidian Headless when its history grows too big.

rows.title: Several KPI lines in one chart
rows.description: A KPI chart can draw several series as lines on one chart (e.g. ClaudeParty native parity on Linux, macOS and Windows), more compact than three charts.
